note: Route tags are our own classification of what each lead would show if it succeeds. A lead can sit on more than one route. The route gauge shows the best-scoring lead on that route.

routes.label: Dishonesty
routes.desc: A document or declaration that misstated the facts to the court, the registry or the occupier.

routes.label: Concealment
routes.desc: A record that existed but was withheld, removed or left out of the file.

routes.label: Public bodies
routes.desc: A step taken by a registry, council, court office or other public body.
